samir: Quick daily check-in from my end (first week).
- What I did: got my Mac imaged, installed dotfiles, signed into Okta + Google Cloud console, ran through the intro docs. Created SSH key pair and uploaded key to my GitHub profile.
- Blockers: can't SSH into our bastion (permission denied), `git clone` of monorepo returns 403, and `gcloud projects list` shows permission denied for my user.
- Today: pair with @priya on infra runbook, finish a tiny PR to add a telemetry stub, and get CI access so I can run tests.

priya: hey! I'll take the pairing. quick checks: did you add the *public* key (the `.pub` file) to GitHub and also to `~/.ssh/known_hosts`? can you paste the output of `ssh -v git@github.com` here?

samir: here's the ssh output I see (redacted):
```\nOpenSSH_8.9p1, LibreSSL 2.8.3\ndebug1: Connecting to github.com [140.82.121.4] port 22.\ndebug1: identity file /Users/samir/.ssh/id_rsa type 0\ndebug1: Authentications that can continue: publickey\ndebug1: Next authentication method: publickey\ndebug1: No more authentication methods available.\nPermission denied (publickey).\n```
I definitely uploaded `id_rsa.pub` to my GitHub account under SSH keys.

alex_infra: I can see an SSH key mismatch in the logs — the key fingerprint on the bastion doesn't match the key you uploaded to GH. Two quick things: (1) make sure the private key on your laptop corresponds to the `.pub` you uploaded (run `ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub`) and (2) add the key to the infra auth list with this command (I'll run for you if you want):
```\n# on your machine\ncat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub | ssh ops@bastion.redwood.internal 'umask 077; cat >> ~/.home_keys/samir.pub'\n```
I've temporarily added `roles/viewer` on `redwood-dev-1` to your user to unblock `gcloud projects list`. Try `gcloud projects list` again and reply here.

samir: ran `ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub` -> `2048 SHA256:ABC... samir@macbook (RSA)`; looks like a match. After your bastion add I'm getting through! `gcloud projects list` now returns projects. Thanks.

priya: for the `git clone` 403 — repo is private and requires org membership + team repo access. I pinged @alex_infra to add you to `eng-infra` team. In the meantime, try cloning via HTTPS with a PAT (short-term) or wait ~10m after we add org access.

liz_peopleops: FYI I've scheduled your equipment stipend onboarding call for tomorrow at 2pm and sent the reimbursement form. Also, welcome again — if anything else needs HR signoff ping me. :tada:

alex_infra: added you to `eng-infra` team and refreshed permissions — you should be able to clone now. Also added your key to the bastion. If you still see a 403 after a few minutes, run:
```\n# clear cached GitHub creds\ngh auth logout --confirm\ngh auth login\n```

onboard-bot: Reminder: pairing session with Priya scheduled in 35m — join link: https://meet.redwood.com/infra-onboard-samir. :robot_face:

samir: awesome, everything unblocked. i'll join the pairing and will open the PR after. thanks everyone! :rocket:
